<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sp_widget"><sp_widget action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><category>custom</category><client_script><![CDATA[/**
 * CLM ADAPTIVE WIDGET — Client Script V5 (TCL + Multi-Segment)
 * Replaces WIDGET_client_v4.js entirely
 */

api.controller = function($scope) {
    var c = this;

    // Core state
    c.data.calc          = {};
    c.data.submitted     = false;
    c.data.submitting    = false;
    c.data.saving        = false;
    c.data.customerError = '';
    c.data.submitError   = '';

    // Multi-segment state
    c.data.isMultiSegment    = false;
    c.data.msMethod          = 'manual';
    c.data.msSegments        = [];
    c.data.msValidationError = '';
    c.data.msTotalSD         = 0;
    c.data.msTotalMACL       = 0;
    c.data.msTotalRequested  = 0;

    // TCL state
    c.data.isTCL          = false;
    c.data.tclAmount      = 0;
    c.data.tclValidTill   = '';
    c.data.tclMinDate     = '';
    c.data.tclDaysLeft    = 0;
    c.data.tclError       = '';
    c.data.tclIncreasePct = 0;
    c.data.permanentLimit = 0;
    c.data.activeTCLs     = [];

    // Set min date for TCL to tomorrow
    var tomorrow = new Date();
    tomorrow.setDate(tomorrow.getDate() + 1);
    c.data.tclMinDate = tomorrow.toISOString().split('T')[0];

    // ── Load customer ──────────────────────────────────────────
    c.loadCustomer = function() {
        var code = (c.data.customerCode || '').trim().toUpperCase();
        if (!code) return;

        c.data.customerError  = '';
        c.data.customerName   = 'Loading...';
        c.data.calc           = {};
        c.data.isMultiSegment = false;
        c.data.isTCL          = false;
        c.data.tclError       = '';
        c.data.activeTCLs     = [];

        c.server.get({ action: 'loadCustomer', customerCode: code })
        .then(function(r) {
            if (r.data.customer) {
                var cust = r.data.customer;
                c.data.customerSysId   = cust.sys_id;
                c.data.customerName    = cust.name;
                c.data.customerType    = cust.customer_type;
                c.data.segment         = cust.segment;
                c.data.zone            = cust.zone;
                c.data.region          = cust.region;
                c.data.cg2Code         = cust.cg2_code;
                c.data.constitution    = cust.constitution;
                c.data.isListed        = cust.is_listed;
                c.data.vintageDays     = cust.vintage_days;
                c.data.currentLimit    = cust.current_limit / 100000;
                c.data.hierarchyLevel  = cust.hierarchy_level;
                c.data.hierarchyData   = cust.hierarchy_data;
                c.data.avgMonthlySales = cust.avg_monthly_sales;
                c.data.orderRate       = cust.order_rate || 7000;
                c.data.permanentLimit  = cust.permanent_limit || 0;
                c.data.activeTCLs      = cust.active_tcls    || [];

                if (cust.outstanding > 0 && !c.data.outstanding)
                    c.data.outstanding = cust.outstanding;
                if (cust.customer_type === 'Trade' && cust.current_sd > 0 && !c.data.activeSD)
                    c.data.activeSD = cust.current_sd;
                if (cust.customer_type !== 'Trade')
                    c.data.activeSD = 0;

                c.initMultiSegment(cust);
                if (c.data.requestedLimit > 0) c.recalculate();
            } else {
                c.data.customerName  = '';
                c.data.customerSysId = '';
                c.data.customerError = 'Customer "' + code + '" not found.';
            }
        });
    };

    c.clearCustomer = function() {
        c.data.customerSysId  = '';
        c.data.customerName   = '';
        c.data.customerType   = '';
        c.data.customerError  = '';
        c.data.segment        = '';
        c.data.calc           = {};
        c.data.activeSD       = 0;
        c.data.outstanding    = 0;
        c.data.isMultiSegment = false;
        c.data.isTCL          = false;
        c.data.tclError       = '';
        c.data.activeTCLs     = [];
        c.data.permanentLimit = 0;
    };

    // ── TCL FUNCTIONS ──────────────────────────────────────────

    c.onTCLToggle = function() {
        c.data.tclError = '';
        if (c.data.isTCL) {
            // Pre-fill TCL amount with current requested limit
            if (c.data.requestedLimit > 0)
                c.data.tclAmount = c.data.requestedLimit;
            c.validateTCL();
        } else {
            c.data.tclAmount    = 0;
            c.data.tclValidTill = '';
            c.data.tclDaysLeft  = 0;
            c.data.tclError     = '';
            c.data.tclIncreasePct = 0;
        }
    };

    c.onTCLAmountChange = function() {
        var perm = parseFloat(c.data.permanentLimit) || 0;
        var tcl  = parseFloat(c.data.tclAmount)      || 0;
        c.data.tclIncreasePct = perm > 0 ? ((tcl - perm) / perm) * 100 : 0;

        // Sync to main requested limit
        if (tcl > 0) c.data.requestedLimit = tcl;
        c.validateTCL();
        c.recalculate();
    };

    c.onTCLDateChange = function() {
        if (!c.data.tclValidTill) { c.data.tclDaysLeft = 0; return; }
        var today  = new Date();
        var target = new Date(c.data.tclValidTill);
        var diff   = Math.ceil((target - today) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
        c.data.tclDaysLeft = diff > 0 ? diff : 0;
        c.validateTCL();
    };

    c.validateTCL = function() {
        c.data.tclError = '';
        if (!c.data.isTCL) return true;

        var tcl  = parseFloat(c.data.tclAmount)      || 0;
        var perm = parseFloat(c.data.permanentLimit)  || 0;

        if (tcl <= 0) {
            c.data.tclError = 'Please enter the TCL amount.';
            return false;
        }
        if (perm > 0 && tcl <= perm) {
            c.data.tclError = 'TCL amount (₹' + (tcl/100000).toFixed(1) + 'L) must exceed the permanent limit (₹' + (perm/100000).toFixed(1) + 'L).';
            return false;
        }
        if (!c.data.tclValidTill) {
            c.data.tclError = 'Please select a Valid Till date.';
            return false;
        }
        if (c.data.tclDaysLeft <= 0) {
            c.data.tclError = 'Valid Till date must be in the future.';
            return false;
        }
        return true;
    };

    c.buildTCLPayload = function() {
        if (!c.data.isTCL) return null;
        return {
            is_tcl:           true,
            tcl_amount:       parseFloat(c.data.tclAmount)     || 0,
            tcl_valid_till:   c.data.tclValidTill,
            permanent_limit:  parseFloat(c.data.permanentLimit) || 0
        };
    };

    // ── MULTI-SEGMENT FUNCTIONS ────────────────────────────────

    c.initMultiSegment = function(cust) {
        var rate = (cust && cust.order_rate)       ? cust.order_rate       : 7000;
        var mpq  = (cust && cust.avg_monthly_sales) ? cust.avg_monthly_sales : 0;
        c.data.msMethod          = 'manual';
        c.data.msValidationError = '';
        c.data.msTotalSD = c.data.msTotalMACL = c.data.msTotalRequested = 0;
        c.data.msSegments = [
            { name: 'Cement', active: true,  sd: parseFloat((cust && cust.current_sd) || 0), mpq: mpq, orderRate: rate, creditTenor: 45, p1: 0, requestedLimit: 0, pct: 0 },
            { name: 'RMC',    active: false, sd: 0, mpq: 0, orderRate: 5500, creditTenor: 30, p1: 0, requestedLimit: 0, pct: 0 },
            { name: 'BPD',    active: false, sd: 0, mpq: 0, orderRate: 4500, creditTenor: 45, p1: 0, requestedLimit: 0, pct: 0 }
        ];
    };

    c.onMultiSegmentToggle = function() {
        c.data.msValidationError = '';
        if (c.data.isMultiSegment) c.recalculateMS();
    };

    c.onMethodChange = function() {
        c.data.msValidationError = '';
        if (c.data.msMethod === 'prorata') c.applyProRata();
    };

    c.recalculateMS = function() {
        if (!c.data.isMultiSegment || !c.data.msSegments) return;
        var totalSD = 0, totalRequested = 0, totalMACL = 0;
        c.data.msSegments.forEach(function(seg) {
            if (!seg.active) { seg.p1 = 0; seg.pct = 0; return; }
            var mpq = parseFloat(seg.mpq) || 0, rate = parseFloat(seg.orderRate) || 7000, tenor = parseFloat(seg.creditTenor) || 45;
            seg.p1 = mpq > 0 ? (mpq * rate * tenor) / 30 : 0;
            totalSD        += parseFloat(seg.sd)             || 0;
            totalRequested += parseFloat(seg.requestedLimit) || 0;
            totalMACL      += seg.p1;
        });
        c.data.msTotalSD = totalSD; c.data.msTotalRequested = totalRequested; c.data.msTotalMACL = totalMACL;
        c.data.msSegments.forEach(function(seg) {
            if (!seg.active || totalRequested === 0) { seg.pct = 0; return; }
            seg.pct = (parseFloat(seg.requestedLimit) || 0) / totalRequested;
        });
        if (c.data.msMethod === 'prorata') c.applyProRata();
        c.validateMS();
        if (totalRequested > 0) { c.data.requestedLimit = totalRequested; c.recalculate(); }
    };

    c.applyProRata = function() {
        if (!c.data.msSegments) return;
        var active = c.data.msSegments.filter(function(s) { return s.active; });
        var totalSD = active.reduce(function(a, s) { return a + (parseFloat(s.sd) || 0); }, 0);
        var totalReq = parseFloat(c.data.requestedLimit) || 0;
        if (totalReq === 0 || active.length === 0) return;
        var allocSum = 0;
        active.forEach(function(seg) {
            var sd = parseFloat(seg.sd) || 0;
            var pct = totalSD > 0 ? sd / totalSD : 1 / active.length;
            seg.requestedLimit = Math.round(totalReq * pct); seg.pct = pct; allocSum += seg.requestedLimit;
        });
        var diff = totalReq - allocSum;
        if (diff !== 0) active[0].requestedLimit += diff;
        c.data.msTotalRequested = totalReq;
    };

    c.onManualLimitChange = function() { c.recalculateMS(); };

    c.validateMS = function() {
        if (!c.data.isMultiSegment || c.data.msMethod === 'hold') { c.data.msValidationError = ''; return true; }
        var active = c.data.msSegments.filter(function(s) { return s.active; });
        if (active.length === 0) { c.data.msValidationError = 'Select at least one segment.'; return false; }
        var sum = active.reduce(function(a, s) { return a + (parseFloat(s.requestedLimit) || 0); }, 0);
        var total = parseFloat(c.data.requestedLimit) || 0;
        if (total > 0 && Math.abs(sum - total) > 100) {
            c.data.msValidationError = 'Segment limits (₹' + (sum/100000).toFixed(1) + 'L) must equal total (₹' + (total/100000).toFixed(1) + 'L)';
            return false;
        }
        c.data.msValidationError = ''; return true;
    };

    c.buildMSPayload = function() {
        if (!c.data.isMultiSegment || !c.data.msSegments) return null;
        return {
            is_multi_segment: true, method: c.data.msMethod,
            segments: c.data.msSegments.filter(function(s) { return s.active; }).map(function(s) {
                return { segment: s.name, sd: parseFloat(s.sd)||0, mpq: parseFloat(s.mpq)||0,
                         order_rate: parseFloat(s.orderRate)||7000, credit_tenor: parseFloat(s.creditTenor)||45,
                         requested_limit: parseFloat(s.requestedLimit)||0, pct: parseFloat(s.pct)||0 };
            })
        };
    };

    // ── Live recalculate ───────────────────────────────────────
    c.recalculate = function() {
        var req = parseFloat(c.data.requestedLimit) || 0;
        if (req <= 0 || !c.data.customerSysId) { c.data.calc = {}; return; }
        c.server.get({
            action: 'calculate', customerType: c.data.customerType || 'Trade',
            customerSysId: c.data.customerSysId, requestedLimit: req,
            activeSD: parseFloat(c.data.activeSD)||0, outstanding: parseFloat(c.data.outstanding)||0,
            avgMonthlySales: parseFloat(c.data.avgMonthlySales)||0,
            salesLastMonth: parseFloat(c.data.salesLastMonth)||0, salesPrevMonth: parseFloat(c.data.salesPrevMonth)||0,
            segment: c.data.segment||'Cement', cg2Code: c.data.cg2Code||'', vintageDays: parseInt(c.data.vintageDays)||0
        }).then(function(r) { if (r.data.calc) c.data.calc = r.data.calc; });
    };

    // ── Save Draft ─────────────────────────────────────────────
    c.saveDraft = function() {
        c.data.saving = true;
        c.server.get({ action: 'saveDraft', form: c.buildPayload() })
        .then(function(r) { c.data.saving = false; c.data.draftSysId = r.data.sysId; c.data.requestNumber = r.data.number; });
    };

    // ── Submit ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
    c.submit = function() {
        c.data.submitError = '';
        if (!c.data.customerSysId)  { c.data.submitError = 'Please select a valid customer.'; return; }
        if (!c.data.segment)         { c.data.submitError = 'Please select a segment.'; return; }
        if (!c.data.justification || c.data.justification.trim().length < 20) {
            c.data.submitError = 'Business justification must be at least 20 characters.'; return; }
        if (c.data.calc.isDeviation && (!c.data.deviationJustification || c.data.deviationJustification.trim().length < 20)) {
            c.data.submitError = 'Deviation justification is required.'; return; }
        if (c.data.isMultiSegment && !c.validateMS()) {
            c.data.submitError = c.data.msValidationError || 'Fix multi-segment errors.'; return; }
        if (c.data.isTCL && !c.validateTCL()) {
            c.data.submitError = c.data.tclError || 'Fix TCL errors.'; return; }

        c.data.submitting = true;
        c.server.get({ action: 'submit', form: c.buildPayload() })
        .then(function(r) {
            c.data.submitting = false;
            if (r.data.success) {
                c.data.submitted = true; c.data.requestNumber = r.data.requestNumber;
                c.data.approverRole = r.data.approverRole; c.data.isDeviation = r.data.isDeviation;
            } else { c.data.submitError = r.data.error || 'Submission failed.'; }
        }).catch(function() { c.data.submitting = false; c.data.submitError = 'Server error.'; });
    };

    c.resetForm = function() {
        c.data = { calc: {}, submitted: false, submitting: false, saving: false,
                   isMultiSegment: false, msMethod: 'manual', msSegments: [],
                   isTCL: false, activeTCLs: [] };
    };

    c.buildPayload = function() {
        var payload = {
            customerSysId: c.data.customerSysId, customerType: c.data.customerType,
            segment: c.data.segment, requestedLimit: c.data.requestedLimit,
            activeSD: c.data.activeSD||0, outstanding: c.data.outstanding||0,
            avgMonthlySales: c.data.avgMonthlySales||0, salesLastMonth: c.data.salesLastMonth||0,
            salesPrevMonth: c.data.salesPrevMonth||0, chequeBounces: c.data.chequeBounces||0,
            marketPerception: c.data.marketPerception||'', justification: c.data.justification,
            deviationJustification: c.data.deviationJustification||'',
            vintageDays: c.data.vintageDays||0, draftSysId: c.data.draftSysId||''
        };
        var msPayload  = c.buildMSPayload();
        var tclPayload = c.buildTCLPayload();
        if (msPayload)  payload.multiSegment = msPayload;
        if (tclPayload) payload.tcl          = tclPayload;
        return payload;
    };
};]]></client_script><controller_as>c</controller_as><css>/* ============================================================
   CLM WIDGET — COMPLETE CSS (UltraTech Theme)
   Brand Colors: Black #000000 | Neon Yellow #FFF21A | White #FFFFFF
   ============================================================ */

/* ── Base ── */
.clm-widget {
  font-family: "Source Sans Pro", "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
  max-width: 960px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  color: #1a1a1a;
}

/* ── Header ── */
.clm-header {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  background: #000000;
  color: #fff;
  padding: 20px 28px;
  border-radius: 8px 8px 0 0;
  margin-bottom: 0;
  border-bottom: 3px solid #FFF21A;
}
.clm-title    { font-size: 20px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.3px; color: #ffffff; }
.clm-subtitle { font-size: 13px; color: rgba(255,242,26,0.75); margin-top: 2px; }
.clm-request-badge {
  background: #FFF21A;
  border: 1px solid #FFF21A;
  color: #000000;
  padding: 4px 14px;
  border-radius: 20px;
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.5px;
}

/* ── Section ── */
.clm-section {
  background: #fff;
  border: 1px solid #e0e0e0;
  border-top: none;
  padding: 24px 28px;
}
.clm-section:last-of-type { border-radius: 0 0 8px 8px; }
.clm-section-title {
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: #000000;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.8px;
  margin-bottom: 18px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
}
.clm-section-num {
  width: 24px; height: 24px;
  background: #FFF21A; color: #000000;
  border-radius: 50%; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

/* ── Form Layout ── */
.clm-row {
  display: flex;
  gap: 20px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  margin-bottom: 16px;
}
.clm-row:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }
.clm-field { flex: 1; min-width: 200px; }
.clm-field label {
  display: block;
  font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600;
  color: #4a4a4a; margin-bottom: 6px;
}
.req { color: #e74c3c; margin-left: 2px; }

.clm-input, .clm-textarea {
  width: 100%;
  padding: 9px 12px;
  border: 1px solid #cccccc;
  border-radius: 5px;
  font-size: 14px; color: #1a1a1a; background: #fff;
  transition: border-color 0.15s, box-shadow 0.15s;
  box-sizing: border-box;
}
.clm-input:focus, .clm-textarea:focus {
  outline: none;
  border-color: #000000;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(255,242,26,0.4);
}
.clm-input[readonly] { background: #f5f5f5; color: #888888; cursor: default; }
.clm-textarea { resize: vertical; min-height: 90px; line-height: 1.5; }
.clm-textarea-danger { border-color: #e74c3c; }
.clm-textarea-danger:focus {
  border-color: #c0392b;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(231,76,60,0.12);
}

/* Input with button */
.clm-input-group { display: flex; gap: 8px; }
.clm-input-group .clm-input { flex: 1; }
.clm-input-btn {
  padding: 9px 16px;
  background: #FFF21A; color: #000000;
  border: none; border-radius: 5px;
  font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700;
  cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap;
  transition: background 0.15s;
}
.clm-input-btn:hover { background: #e6d900; }
.clm-input-btn:disabled { background: #e0e0e0; color: #999999; cursor: not-allowed; }

.clm-field-hint { font-size: 12px; color: #888888; margin-top: 4px; }
.clm-field-msg  { font-size: 12px; margin-top: 4px; }
.clm-error      { color: #e74c3c; }

/* ── Customer Strip ── */
.clm-customer-strip {
  display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px;
  margin-top: 16px; padding: 12px 16px;
  background: #f5f5f5;
  border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid #e0e0e0;
}
.clm-strip-item  { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; min-width: 100px; }
.clm-strip-label { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.5px; color: #888888; }
.clm-strip-value { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: #1a1a1a; }

/* Customer type colors */
.clm-type-trade    { color: #000000; }
.clm-type-nontrade { color: #8e44ad; }
.clm-type-key      { color: #c8860a; }

/* ── Calc Panel ── */

    var action = input && input.action;

    // ── loadCustomer ──────────────────────────────────────────
    if (action === 'loadCustomer') {

        var custGr = new GlideRecord('x_birl3_clm_clm_customer_master1');
        custGr.addQuery('customer_code_sap', (input.customerCode + '').trim().toUpperCase());
        custGr.setLimit(1);
        custGr.query();

        if (!custGr.next()) { data.customer = null; return; }

        var vintageDays = 0;
        var fos = custGr.first_order_date + '';
        if (fos && fos !== '' && fos !== 'null') {
            var fd = new GlideDate(); fd.setValue(fos);
            var td = new GlideDate();
            var dd = Math.floor((td.getNumericValue() - fd.getNumericValue()) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
            vintageDays = dd > 0 ? dd : 0;
        }

        var outstanding = 0;
        var agGr = new GlideRecord('x_birl3_clm_clm_aging_snapshot');
        agGr.addQuery('customer', custGr.sys_id + '');
        agGr.orderByDesc('snapshot_month');
        agGr.setLimit(1);
        agGr.query();
        if (agGr.next()) outstanding = parseFloat(agGr.total_outstanding) || 0;

        var permanentLimit = 0;
        var pGr = new GlideRecord('x_birl3_clm_clm_new_credit_request');
        pGr.addQuery('customer', custGr.sys_id + '');
        pGr.addQuery('state',    'Approved');
        pGr.addQuery('is_tcl',   false);
        pGr.orderByDesc('sys_created_on');
        pGr.setLimit(1);
        pGr.query();
        if (pGr.next()) permanentLimit = parseFloat(pGr.approved_limit) || 0;

        data.customer = {
            sys_id:            custGr.sys_id + '',
            name:              custGr.customer_name + '',
            customer_type:     custGr.customer_type + '',
            segment:           custGr.segment + '',
            zone:              custGr.zone + '',
            region:            custGr.region + '',
            cg2_code:          custGr.cg2_code + '',
            vintage_days:      vintageDays,
            current_sd:        parseFloat(custGr.current_sd_amount)    || 0,
            current_limit:     parseFloat(custGr.current_credit_limit) || 0,
            avg_monthly_sales: parseFloat(custGr.avg_monthly_sales_mt) || 0,
            order_rate:        7000,
            outstanding:       outstanding,
            permanent_limit:   permanentLimit,
            active_tcls:       []
        };
    }

    // ── calculate ─────────────────────────────────────────────
    else if (action === 'calculate') {

        var custSysId = input.customerSysId || '';
        var req       = parseFloat(input.requestedLimit)  || 0;
        var sd        = parseFloat(input.activeSD)        || 0;
        var os        = parseFloat(input.outstanding)     || 0;
        var avg       = parseFloat(input.avgMonthlySales) || 0;
        var segment   = input.segment    || 'Cement';
        var cg2Code   = input.cg2Code    || '';
        var vin       = parseInt(input.vintageDays) || 0;

        // Aging
        var total=0, safe=0, warning=0, critical=0, toxic=0, mCount=0;
        var salesLast=0, salesPrev=0;

        var agGr2 = new GlideRecord('x_birl3_clm_clm_aging_snapshot');
        agGr2.addQuery('customer', custSysId);
        agGr2.orderByDesc('snapshot_month');
        agGr2.setLimit(6);
        agGr2.query();

        while (agGr2.next()) {
            mCount++;
            total    += parseFloat(agGr2.total_outstanding)   || 0;
            safe     += (parseFloat(agGr2.bucket_0_30_days)   || 0)
                      + (parseFloat(agGr2.bucket_31_45_days)  || 0)
                      + (parseFloat(agGr2.bucket_46_60_days)  || 0);
            warning  += parseFloat(agGr2.bucket_61_75_days)   || 0;
            critical += parseFloat(agGr2.bucket_76_90_days)   || 0;
            toxic    += (parseFloat(agGr2.bucket_91_120_days) || 0)
                      + (parseFloat(agGr2.bucket_gt120_days)  || 0);
            if (mCount === 1) {
                salesLast = parseFloat(agGr2.sales_current_month) || 0;
                salesPrev = parseFloat(agGr2.sales_prev_month)    || 0;
            }
        }

        // Aging rating
        var agRating = 'A';
        if (total > 0) {
            var sp = safe  / total;
            var tp = (critical + toxic) / total;
            if      (sp >= 0.80 && tp <= 0.10) agRating = 'A';
            else if (sp >= 0.60 && tp <= 0.20) agRating = 'B';
            else                                agRating = 'C';
        }

        // NOD
        var nod = 0;
        var avg2M = (salesLast + salesPrev) / 2;
        if (vin <= 60) {
            if (avg > 0) nod = Math.ceil((os / avg) * Math.min(vin, 60));
        } else {
            if (avg2M > 0) nod = Math.round((os / avg2M) * 30);
        }

        // Multiplier
        var multiplier = 1;
        if (vin < 90) {
            multiplier = 1;
        } else if (vin < 180) {
            multiplier = (nod < 15 && avg > 1000) ? 2 : 1;
        } else {
            var mGr = new GlideRecord('x_birl3_clm_clm_multiplier');
            mGr.addQuery('cg2_code',  cg2Code);
            mGr.addQuery('segment',   segment);
            mGr.addQuery('is_active', true);
            mGr.setLimit(1);
            mGr.query();
            if (mGr.next()) multiplier = parseInt(mGr.multiplier) || 1;
            else {
                if      (cg2Code === 'CG2_A' || cg2Code === 'PMNT_GOOD') multiplier = 4;
                else if (cg2Code === 'CG2_B')                              multiplier = 2;
                else                                                        multiplier = 1;
            }
        }

        var netExp   = Math.max(0, req - sd);
        var maxAllw  = sd * multiplier;
        var implMult = sd > 0 ? req / sd : 0;
        var isDev    = req > maxAllw;

        // Pass vintageDays to router for BPD logic
        var router   = new CLMApprovalRouter();
        var approver = router.getApprover(segment, 'Trade', netExp, nod, isDev, implMult, vin);

        data.calc = {
            multiplier:   multiplier,
            maxAllowable: maxAllw  / 100000,
            netExposure:  netExp   / 100000,
            impliedMult:  implMult,
            isDeviation:  isDev,
            nod:          nod,
            agingRating:  agRating,
            approverRole: approver.role,
            escalated:    approver.escalated || false,
            reason:       approver.reason    || ''
        };
    }

    // ── saveDraft ─────────────────────────────────────────────
    else if (action === 'saveDraft') {
        var f  = input.form;
        var gr = new GlideRecord('x_birl3_clm_clm_new_credit_request');
        if (f.draftSysId) gr.get(f.draftSysId); else gr.initialize();
        gr.customer_type           = f.customerType;
        gr.segment                 = f.segment;
        gr.customer                = f.customerSysId;
        gr.requested_limit         = f.requestedLimit;
        gr.active_sd               = f.activeSD;
        gr.outstanding_amount      = f.outstanding;
        gr.avg_monthly_sales       = f.avgMonthlySales;
        gr.sales_last_month        = f.salesLastMonth;
        gr.sales_prev_month        = f.salesPrevMonth;
        gr.cheque_bounces_12m      = f.chequeBounces;
        gr.market_perception       = f.marketPerception;
        gr.business_justification  = f.justification;
        gr.deviation_justification = f.deviationJustification;
        gr.state                   = 'Draft';
        gr.initiator               = gs.getUserID();
        var sysId = f.draftSysId ? gr.update() : gr.insert();
        var gr2 = new GlideRecord('x_birl3_clm_clm_new_credit_request');
        gr2.get(sysId);
        data.sysId  = sysId;
        data.number = gr2.request_number + '';
    }

    // ── submit ────────────────────────────────────────────────
    else if (action === 'submit') {
        var f = input.form;
        try {
            var gr = new GlideRecord('x_birl3_clm_clm_new_credit_request');
            gr.initialize();
            gr.customer_type           = f.customerType;
            gr.segment                 = f.segment;
            gr.customer                = f.customerSysId;
            gr.requested_limit         = f.requestedLimit;
            gr.active_sd               = f.activeSD;
            gr.outstanding_amount      = f.outstanding;
            gr.avg_monthly_sales       = f.avgMonthlySales;
            gr.sales_last_month        = f.salesLastMonth;
            gr.sales_prev_month        = f.salesPrevMonth;
            gr.cheque_bounces_12m      = f.chequeBounces;
            gr.market_perception       = f.marketPerception;
            gr.business_justification  = f.justification;
            gr.deviation_justification = f.deviationJustification;
            gr.initiator               = gs.getUserID();
            gr.state                   = 'Submitted';

            if (f.multiSegment && f.multiSegment.is_multi_segment) {
                gr.is_multi_segment      = true;
                gr.total_requested_limit = f.requestedLimit;
            }

            var sysId = gr.insert();
            if (!sysId) { data.success = false; data.error = 'Failed to create request.'; return; }

            var result = new GlideRecord('x_birl3_clm_clm_new_credit_request');
            result.get(sysId);
            data.success       = true;
            data.requestNumber = result.request_number + '';
            data.approverRole  = result.required_approver_level + '';
            data.isDeviation   = result.is_deviation + '' === 'true';
            data.sysId         = sysId;

        } catch(e) {
            data.success = false;
            data.error   = 'Error: ' + e.message;
        }
    }

-->

<div class="clm-widget">

  <!-- ── HEADER ── -->
  <div class="clm-header">
    <div class="clm-header-left">
      <div class="clm-title">
        <span ng-if="!c.data.customerType || c.data.customerType == 'Trade'">Trade Customer</span>
        <span ng-if="c.data.customerType == 'Non-Trade'">Non-Trade Customer</span>
        <span ng-if="c.data.customerType == 'Key'">Key Customer</span>
      </div>
      <div class="clm-subtitle">Credit Limit Request</div>
    </div>
    <div class="clm-header-right" ng-if="c.data.requestNumber">
      <div class="clm-request-badge">{{c.data.requestNumber}}</div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- ── SUCCESS STATE ── -->
  <div class="clm-success-panel" ng-if="c.data.submitted">
    <div class="clm-success-icon">✓</div>
    <h3>Request Submitted Successfully</h3>
    <p>Request <strong>{{c.data.requestNumber}}</strong> has been created and routed to <strong>{{c.data.approverRole}}</strong> for approval.</p>
    <div ng-if="c.data.isDeviation" class="clm-deviation-note">
      ⚠ This is a deviation request — approval requires justification review.
    </div>
    <button class="clm-btn clm-btn-outline" ng-click="c.resetForm()">Submit Another Request</button>
  </div>

  <!-- ── MAIN FORM ── -->
  <form name="clmForm" ng-submit="c.submit()" ng-if="!c.data.submitted">

    <!-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
         SECTION 1: CUSTOMER DETAILS (same for all types)
    ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
    <div class="clm-section">
      <div class="clm-section-title">
        <span class="clm-section-num">1</span> Customer Details
      </div>

      <div class="clm-row">
        <div class="clm-field">
          <label>Customer Code (SAP) <span class="req">*</span></label>
          <div class="clm-input-group">
            <input type="text"
                   ng-model="c.data.customerCode"
                   ng-blur="c.loadCustomer()"
                   ng-change="c.clearCustomer()"
                   placeholder="e.g. NT001 or KEY_C001"
                   class="clm-input" required />
            <button type="button" class="clm-input-btn"
                    ng-click="c.loadCustomer()"
                    ng-disabled="!c.data.customerCode">Search</button>
          </div>
          <div class="clm-field-msg clm-error" ng-if="c.data.customerError">
            {{c.data.customerError}}
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="clm-field">
          <label>Customer Name</label>
          <input type="text" ng-model="c.data.customerName"
                 class="clm-input" readonly placeholder="Auto-filled on search" />
        </div>

        <div class="clm-field">
  <label>Segment <span class="req">*</span></label>
  <input type="text" ng-model="c.data.segment"
         class="clm-input"
         readonly placeholder="Auto-filled from customer master" />

  <div class="clm-field-hint" ng-if="c.data.segment">
    Auto-filled from customer master.
  </div>
</div>

      <!-- Customer info strip -->
      <div class="clm-customer-strip" ng-if="c.data.customerName">
        <div class="clm-strip-item">
          <span class="clm-strip-label">Type</span>
          <span class="clm-strip-value"
                ng-class="{
                  'clm-type-trade':    c.data.customerType == 'Trade',
                  'clm-type-nontrade': c.data.customerType == 'Non-Trade',
                  'clm-type-key':      c.data.customerType == 'Key'
                }">
            {{c.data.customerType || '—'}}
          </span>
        </div>
        <div class="clm-strip-item">
          <span class="clm-strip-label">Zone</span>
          <span class="clm-strip-value">{{c.data.zone || '—'}}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="clm-strip-item">
          <span class="clm-strip-label">Region</span>
          <span class="clm-strip-value">{{c.data.region || '—'}}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="clm-strip-item" ng-if="c.data.customerType == 'Trade'">
          <span class="clm-strip-label">CG2 Code</span>
          <span class="clm-strip-value">{{c.data.cg2Code || '—'}}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="clm-strip-item" ng-if="c.data.customerType != 'Trade'">
          <span class="clm-strip-label">Constitution</span>
          <span class="clm-strip-value">{{c.data.constitution || '—'}}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="clm-strip-item" ng-if="c.data.customerType != 'Trade'">
          <span class="clm-strip-label">Listed</span>
          <span class="clm-strip-value">{{c.data.isListed ? 'Yes' : 'No'}}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="clm-strip-item">
          <span class="clm-strip-label">Customer Since</span>
          <span class="clm-strip-value">{{c.data.vintageDays}} days</span>
        </div>
        <div class="clm-strip-item">
          <span class="clm-strip-label">Current Limit</span>
          <span class="clm-strip-value">₹{{c.data.currentLimit | number:2}}L</span>
        </div>
        <!-- Key customer hierarchy -->
        <div class="clm-strip-item" ng-if="c.data.customerType == 'Key' && c.data.hierarchyLevel">
          <span class="clm-strip-label">Hierarchy Level</span>
          <span class="clm-strip-value">{{c.data.hierarchyLevel}}</span>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
         SECTION 2A: TRADE — Credit Limit & SD
    ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
 <div class="clm-section" ng-if="c.data.customerType == 'Trade'">
  <div class="clm-section-title">
    <span class="clm-section-num">2</span> Credit Limit & Security Deposit
  </div>

  <!-- Input Row -->
  <div class="clm-row">
    
    <div class="clm-field">
      <label>Active Security Deposit (₹) <span class="req">*</span></label>
      <input type="number" ng-model="c.data.activeSD"
             class="clm-input" min="0" readonly />
    </div>

    <div class="clm-field">
      <label>Requested Credit Limit (₹) <span class="req">*</span></label>
      <input type="number" ng-model="c.data.requestedLimit"
             ng-change="c.recalculate()" class="clm-input" min="0" required />
    </div>

    <div class="clm-field">
      <label>Current Outstanding (₹) <span class="req">*</span></label>
      <input type="number" ng-model="c.data.outstanding"
             class="clm-input" min="0" readonly />
    </div>

  </div>

  <!-- Single Row for Live Calculations -->
  <div class="clm-row clm-field-hint" 
       ng-if="c.data.activeSD || c.data.requestedLimit || c.data.outstanding">
       
    <div class="clm-field" ng-if="c.data.activeSD">
      Active SD: ₹{{c.data.activeSD / 100000 | number:2}} Lakhs
    </div>

    <div class="clm-field" ng-if="c.data.requestedLimit">
      Requested Limit: ₹{{c.data.requestedLimit / 100000 | number:2}} Lakhs
    </div>

    <div class="clm-field" ng-if="c.data.outstanding">
      Outstanding: ₹{{c.data.outstanding / 100000 | number:2}} Lakhs
    </div>

  </div>
</div>
    <!-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
         SECTION 2B: NON-TRADE / KEY — Credit Limit Request
    ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
    <div class="clm-section"
         ng-if="c.data.customerType == 'Non-Trade' || c.data.customerType == 'Key'">
      <div class="clm-section-title">
        <span class="clm-section-num">2</span> Credit Limit Request
      </div>

      <div class="clm-row">
        <div class="clm-field">
          <label>Requested Credit Limit (₹) <span class="req">*</span></label>
          <input type="number" ng-model="c.data.requestedLimit"
                 ng-change="c.recalculate()" class="clm-input" min="0" required />
          <div class="clm-field-hint" ng-if="c.data.requestedLimit">
            ₹{{c.data.requestedLimit / 100000 | number:2}} Lakhs
            <span class="clm-path-badge"
                  ng-class="c.data.calc.workflowPath == 'Tool' ? 'clm-badge-tool' : 'clm-badge-nontool'"
                  ng-if="c.data.calc.workflowPath">
              {{c.data.calc.workflowPath}} Working
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="clm-field">
          <label>Active BG/LC (₹) <small style="color:#aaa">if any</small></label>
          <input type="number" ng-model="c.data.activeSD"
                 ng-change="c.recalculate()" class="clm-input" min="0"
                 placeholder="0 if no collateral" />
          <div class="clm-field-hint" ng-if="c.data.activeSD > 0">
            ₹{{c.data.activeSD / 100000 | number:2}} Lakhs
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="clm-field">
          <label>Current Outstanding (₹)</label>
          <input type="number" ng-model="c.data.outstanding"
                 class="clm-input" min="0" placeholder="Auto-loaded from aging" />
          <div class="clm-field-hint" ng-if="c.data.outstanding">
            ₹{{c.data.outstanding / 100000 | number:2}} Lakhs
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
         LIVE CALCULATION PANEL — TRADE
    ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
    <div class="clm-calc-panel"
         ng-if="c.data.customerType == 'Trade' && c.data.activeSD > 0 && c.data.requestedLimit > 0">
      <div class="clm-calc-title">Live Calculation</div>
      <div class="clm-calc-grid">
        <div class="clm-calc-card">
          <div class="clm-calc-label">System Multiplier</div>
          <div class="clm-calc-value">{{c.data.calc.multiplier || '—'}}x</div>
          <div class="clm-calc-sub">Based on {{c.data.vintageDays}} days vintage</div>
        </div>
        <div class="clm-calc-card">
          <div class="clm-calc-label">Max Allowable</div>
          <div class="clm-calc-value">₹{{c.data.calc.maxAllowable | number:2}}L</div>
          <div class="clm-calc-sub">SD × Multiplier</div>
        </div>
        <div class="clm-calc-card">
          <div class="clm-calc-label">Net Exposure</div>
          <div class="clm-calc-value">₹{{c.data.calc.netExposure | number:2}}L</div>
          <div class="clm-calc-sub">Requested − SD</div>
        </div>
        <div class="clm-calc-card">
          <div class="clm-calc-label">Implied Multiplier</div>
          <div class="clm-calc-value"
               ng-class="c.data.calc.isDeviation ? 'clm-val-danger' : 'clm-val-ok'">
            {{c.data.calc.impliedMult | number:2}}x
          </div>
          <div class="clm-calc-sub">Requested ÷ SD</div>
        </div>
        <div class="clm-calc-card">
          <div class="clm-calc-label">Approver</div>
          <div class="clm-calc-value clm-val-approver">{{c.data.calc.approverRole || '—'}}</div>
          <div class="clm-calc-sub" ng-if="c.data.calc.escalated" style="color:#e74c3c">
            ↑ Escalated
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="clm-calc-card">
          <div class="clm-calc-label">Aging Rating</div>
          <div class="clm-calc-value"
               ng-class="{
                 'clm-val-ok':     c.data.calc.agingRating == 'A',
                 'clm-val-warn':   c.data.calc.agingRating == 'B',
                 'clm-val-danger': c.data.calc.agingRating == 'C'
               }">
            {{c.data.calc.agingRating || '—'}}
          </div>
          <div class="clm-calc-sub">6-month history</div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <!-- Deviation alert -->
      <div class="clm-alert clm-alert-danger" ng-if="c.data.calc.isDeviation">
        <div class="clm-alert-icon">⚠</div>
        <div class="clm-alert-body">
          <strong>Deviation</strong> — Implied {{c.data.calc.impliedMult | number:2}}x exceeds system {{c.data.calc.multiplier}}x. Higher approval required.
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="clm-alert clm-alert-success" ng-if="!c.data.calc.isDeviation">
        <div class="clm-alert-icon">✓</div>
        <div class="clm-alert-body"><strong>Within Limits</strong> — Routes to <strong>{{c.data.calc.approverRole}}</strong></div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
         LIVE CALCULATION PANEL — NON-TRADE / KEY
    ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
    <div class="clm-calc-panel"
         ng-if="(c.data.customerType == 'Non-Trade' || c.data.customerType == 'Key') && c.data.requestedLimit > 0 && c.data.calc.p1">
      <div class="clm-calc-title">
        P1 × P2 × P3 Calculation
        <span class="clm-path-badge"
              ng-class="c.data.calc.workflowPath == 'Tool' ? 'clm-badge-tool' : 'clm-badge-nontool'">
          {{c.data.calc.workflowPath}} Working
        </span>
      </div>
      <div class="clm-calc-grid">
        <div class="clm-calc-card">
          <div class="clm-calc-label">P1 — MACL</div>
          <div class="clm-calc-value">₹{{c.data.calc.p1 | number:1}}L</div>
          <div class="clm-calc-sub">{{c.data.isListed ? 'Net Worth based' : 'MPQ based'}}</div>
        </div>
        <div class="clm-calc-card">
          <div class="clm-calc-label">P2 — Composite</div>
          <div class="clm-calc-value">{{(c.data.calc.p2 * 100) | number:1}}%</div>
          <div class="clm-calc-sub">Operational score</div>
        </div>
        <div class="clm-calc-card">
          <div class="clm-calc-label">P3 — Credit</div>
          <div class="clm-calc-value"
               ng-class="{
                 'clm-val-ok':     c.data.calc.p3 >= 0.75,
                 'clm-val-warn':   c.data.calc.p3 >= 0.5 && c.data.calc.p3 < 0.75,
                 'clm-val-danger': c.data.calc.p3 < 0.5
               }">
            {{(c.data.calc.p3 * 100) | number:0}}%
          </div>
          <div class="clm-calc-sub">{{c.data.calc.creditKey || '—'}}</div>
        </div>
        <div class="clm-calc-card"
             ng-class="c.data.calc.isDeviation ? 'clm-calc-card-danger' : 'clm-calc-card-safe'">
          <div class="clm-calc-label">Safe Allowable</div>
          <div class="clm-calc-value"
               ng-class="c.data.calc.isDeviation ? 'clm-val-danger' : 'clm-val-ok'">
            ₹{{c.data.calc.safeLimit | number:1}}L
          </div>
          <div class="clm-calc-sub">P1 × P2 × P3</div>
        </div>
        <div class="clm-calc-card">
          <div class="clm-calc-label">Approver</div>
          <div class="clm-calc-value clm-val-approver">{{c.data.calc.approverRole || '—'}}</div>
          <div class="clm-calc-sub" ng-if="c.data.calc.escalated" style="color:#e74c3c">
            ↑ Escalated
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="clm-calc-card">
          <div class="clm-calc-label">Aging Rating</div>
          <div class="clm-calc-value"
               ng-class="{
                 'clm-val-ok':     c.data.calc.agingRating == 'a' || c.data.calc.agingRating == 'A',
                 'clm-val-warn':   c.data.calc.agingRating == 'b' || c.data.calc.agingRating == 'B',
                 'clm-val-danger': c.data.calc.agingRating == 'c' || c.data.calc.agingRating == 'C'
               }">
            {{c.data.calc.agingRating || '—'}}
          </div>
          <div class="clm-calc-sub">6-month history</div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- NT Deviation alert -->
      <div class="clm-alert clm-alert-danger" ng-if="c.data.calc.isDeviation">
        <div class="clm-alert-icon">⚠</div>
        <div class="clm-alert-body">
          <strong>Deviation</strong> — Requested ₹{{c.data.requestedLimit / 100000 | number:1}}L exceeds
          Safe Allowable Limit ₹{{c.data.calc.safeLimit | number:1}}L.
          Mandatory deviation justification required below.
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="clm-alert clm-alert-success" ng-if="!c.data.calc.isDeviation">
        <div class="clm-alert-icon">✓</div>
        <div class="clm-alert-body">
          <strong>Within Safe Limit</strong> — Routes to <strong>{{c.data.calc.approverRole}}</strong>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
         SECTION 3A: TRADE — Sales & Risk Data
    ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
    <div class="clm-section" ng-if="c.data.customerType == 'Trade'">
      <div class="clm-section-title">
        <span class="clm-section-num">3</span> Sales & Risk Data
      </div>
      <div class="clm-row">
        <div class="clm-field">
          <label>Avg Monthly Sales — Last 12M (MT)</label>
          <input type="number" ng-model="c.data.avgMonthlySales"
                 ng-change="c.recalculate()" class="clm-input" min="0" />
        </div>
        <div class="clm-field">
          <label>Sales Last Month (₹)</label>
          <input type="number" ng-model="c.data.salesLastMonth" class="clm-input" min="0" />
        </div>
        <div class="clm-field">
          <label>Sales Previous Month (₹)</label>
          <input type="number" ng-model="c.data.salesPrevMonth" class="clm-input" min="0" />
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="clm-row">
        <div class="clm-field">
          <label>Cheque Bounces (Last 12 Months)</label>
          <input type="number" ng-model="c.data.chequeBounces" class="clm-input" min="0" />
        </div>
        <div class="clm-field">
          <label>Market Perception</label>
          <select ng-model="c.data.marketPerception" class="clm-input">
            <option value="">-- Select --</option>
            <option value="A">A — Good</option>
            <option value="B">B — Average</option>
            <option value="C">C — Non-Consistent</option>
            <option value="D">D — Defaulter</option>
          </select>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
         SECTION 3B: NON-TRADE / KEY — Project & Risk Data
    ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
    <div class="clm-section"
         ng-if="c.data.customerType == 'Non-Trade' || c.data.customerType == 'Key'">
      <div class="clm-section-title">
        <span class="clm-section-num">3</span> Project & Risk Data
      </div>
      <div class="clm-row">
        <div class="clm-field">
          <label>Sales Last Month (₹)</label>
          <input type="number" ng-model="c.data.salesLastMonth" class="clm-input" min="0" />
        </div>
        <div class="clm-field">
          <label>Sales Previous Month (₹)</label>
          <input type="number" ng-model="c.data.salesPrevMonth" class="clm-input" min="0" />
        </div>
        <div class="clm-field">
          <label>Market Perception</label>
          <select ng-model="c.data.marketPerception" class="clm-input">
            <option value="">-- Select --</option>
            <option value="A">A — Good</option>
            <option value="B">B — Average</option>
            <option value="C">C — Non-Consistent</option>
            <option value="D">D — Defaulter</option>
          </select>
        </div>
      </div>
      <!-- Key customer: show current exposure across hierarchy -->
      <div ng-if="c.data.customerType == 'Key' && c.data.hierarchyData" class="clm-hierarchy-strip">
        <div class="clm-hierarchy-title">Group Exposure</div>
        <div ng-repeat="node in c.data.hierarchyData" class="clm-hierarchy-node">
          <span class="clm-hierarchy-level">{{node.level}}</span>
          <span class="clm-hierarchy-name">{{node.name}}</span>
          <span class="clm-hierarchy-limit">₹{{node.limit | number:1}}L active</span>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
         SECTION 4: BUSINESS JUSTIFICATION (all types)
    ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
    <div class="clm-section" ng-if="c.data.customerType == 'Trade'">
      <div class="clm-section-title">
        <span class="clm-section-num">4</span> Business Justification <span class="req">*</span>
      </div>
      <textarea ng-model="c.data.justification"
                class="clm-textarea" rows="4"
                placeholder="Explain the business reason for this credit limit request..."
                required></textarea>

      <!-- Deviation justification (all types) -->
      <div ng-if="c.data.calc.isDeviation" style="margin-top:12px">
        <label style="font-weight:600;color:#c0392b">
          Deviation Justification <span class="req">*</span>
          <small>(Required — request exceeds safe limit)</small>
        </label>
        <textarea ng-model="c.data.deviationJustification"
                  class="clm-textarea clm-textarea-danger" rows="3"
                  placeholder="Explain why the requested limit exceeds the calculated safe limit..."
                  ng-required="c.data.calc.isDeviation"></textarea>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- ERROR -->
    <div class="clm-alert clm-alert-danger" ng-if="c.data.submitError">
      <div class="clm-alert-icon">✗</div>
      <div class="clm-alert-body">{{c.data.submitError}}</div>
    </div>

    <!-- ACTIONS -->
    <div class="clm-actions">
      <button type="button" class="clm-btn clm-btn-outline"
              ng-click="c.saveDraft()" ng-disabled="c.data.saving">
        {{c.data.saving ? 'Saving...' : 'Save Draft'}}
      </button>
      <button type="submit" class="clm-btn clm-btn-primary"
              ng-disabled="clmForm.$invalid || c.data.submitting || !c.data.customerSysId">
        {{c.data.submitting ? 'Submitting...' : 'Submit for Approval'}}
      </button>
    </div>

  </form>
</div>]]></template></sp_widget></record_update>
